games.name: The Maze
games.desc:
WARNING: FLASHING LIGHTS AND LOUD NOISES!

------- SHORT ANNOUNCEMENT.
At the moment, this game is in a very early state, me and my small team have been working on a REBOOT for this game, planning out story elements, designs and ideas for the future of this project.
Development on The Maze Reboot has been a bit slow due to things like life but also because of my other projects which I will soon be finishing so I can dedicate myself to this game once again!
However, I do want to announce that I plan to get a DEMO for The Maze Reboot out sometime in the future (also known as Update 4.5). Who knows how long it will take but thank you all for the support on this small project!
This is only the beginning!
---------------------------------------------

This game was made for people looking for a scare. Perhaps people who like exploring. This is a very open game but once you get into the Maze, it gets very enclosed.

games.name: 🏥 Hospital Map! | Blox Hunt v3.2.0
games.desc:
Check out Blox Hunt's sequel, Hide N' Find! https://www.roblox.com/games/4653158113/Hide-N-Find

Blox Hunt is a hide and seek style game with a twist: you become objects to hide in with the surroundings. 

Players are randomly selected to become Hiders and Seekers. The Hiders must blend in with the environment in order to avoid capture from the Seekers. If caught, they become a Seeker. The game ends if every Hider becomes a Seeker or the time runs out.
